implementation.hash_scope: src/**/*.py + benchmark.py + experiments/contract.json; path NUL bytes NUL

memory_target.note: structural array storage, NOT process RSS

measurement.timed_scope: fresh analyzer initialization, all trace analysis, curve construction; excludes file IO and normalization
measurement.memory: separate fresh subprocess ru_maxrss, including input loading; macOS bytes/Linux KiB normalized

contract.semantics: serial completed requests; all membership queries before request touches; equal full blocks; all pages touched left-to-right; no pinning, output insertion, TTL or concurrent requests

data.selection: first N records in file order, no sorting or performance-based selection
data.transformation: drop incomplete final block, chain supplied block IDs with namespace; input tokens include uncached remainder

input.normalized_hash_encoding: UTF-8 compact JSON object per request + LF; original order
